defendant: Prestige Worldwide Consulting Group Limited Liability Company and Jason Jones
description:
Shaun Golden
MONMOUNTY COUNTY SHERIFF
NOTICE OF FORECLOSURE SALE
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MONMOUTH COUNTY
CHANCERY DIVISION
Docket No. L-179321
Sheriff’s File # 24002265
PLAINTIFF – MMG Investments III, LLC vs:
DEFENDANTS- Prestige Worldwide Consulting Group Limited Liability Company and Jason Jones
By virtue of a writ of execution in the above stated action to me directed, I shall expose for sale at public vendue, at Monmouth County Sheriff’s Office Public Safety Center, 2500 Kozloski Road, in the township of Freehold, county of Monmouth, New Jersey, on
Monday, the 17th day of August 2026
at 1 o’clock, P.M. prevailing time. The property to be sold is located in Neptune, in the County of Monmouth, State of New Jersey.
Lot Block Number if available: Tax Lot Nos. 49 in Block No. 3401 Tax Map of Township of Neptune
COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
23 Brookside Road Neptune, NJ 07753
Dimensions of Lot: (Approximately) 100' x 100'
Nearest Cross Street: Hillview Drive
Occupancy status: Unknown
The approximate upset amount is the sum of $350,000.00. The upset amount may be subject to further Orders for additional sums.
Additionally, this sale is subject to a First Mortgage to AVB Investment, LLC in the original amount of $125,000.00 (current balance unknown) as well as the sum of $0.00 is the amount represented to Plaintiff, by the Tax Collector's Office for the Township of Neptune and/or Tax Certificate Holders, as being outstanding on account of taxes and/or other liens due and owing through June 24, 2026 on Lot 49. This sale is also subject to any and all other unpaid taxes, water, sewer, municipal liens or any other charges which may be due and owing whether sew forth herein or not.
ALL INTERESTED PARTIES ARE TO CONDUCT AND RELY UPON THEIR OWN INDEPENDENT INVESTIGATION TO ASCERTAIN WHETHER OR NOT ANY OUTSTANDING LIENS OR ENCUMBRANCES REMAIN OF RECORD AND/OR HAVE PRIORITY OVER THE LIEN BEING FORECLOSED HEREBY AND, IF SO, TO ASCERTAIN THE CURRENT AMOUNT DUE THEREON.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
A full legal description of the premises can be found in the Office of The Sheriff of Monmouth County.
TERMS OF SALE: DEPOSIT: 20% of the bid amount at the time of sale. Balance due in 30 days. Cash (with a limit of $1,000.00) or cashier’s check only.
The approximate judgment amount is the sum of $654,765.31.
The judgment amount may be subject to further Orders of additional sums. The successful bidder will be responsible for all fees, commissions and costs of sale.
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice by publication.
Shaun Golden, Sheriff
DATED: June 24, 2026
Saldutti Law Group
1040 North Kings Highway
Suite 100
Cherry Hill, NJ 08034
856-779-0300
